scope: Incremental source synchronization for attachments, data collections, extensions, soft deletion, and bilingualism concept pairs. General readability review follows separately.

groups.name: Attachment actions and record identity
groups.contract: Role-visible actions can warn when exact assignment, lifecycle, agreement protection or storage prerequisites prevent execution. Record or Agency changes close and clear the draft. Provider metadata read errors fail the full list rather than report no attachments. Existing partial-save recovery remains accurate.

groups.name: Intake attachment type edits
groups.contract: An explicitly changed Intake attachment type must have an active association with its Opportunity as well as remain an active Agency type.

groups.name: Extension workspace navigation
groups.contract: The workspace declaration chooses management or administration and a safe integer order; the host uses it to group and order authorized enabled workspace entries. User concepts name the menu groups without SDK internals.

groups.name: Data collection presentation
groups.contract: Localized toast helper and common action button migrations preserve existing publication and answering behavior. No source-sync content change required.

groups.name: Soft deletion and bilingualism
groups.contract: JSON persistence and localization changes do not change the documented user meaning of deletion or language switching. Existing bilingual drafts, translation suggestions and retained-history guidance remain applicable.

tests_inspected_not_executed.evidence: Read provider metadata failures, operation timeout and abort signal, recorded-provider absence, and non-workable target cases.
